_note: Edit to open/close roles. Applications arrive in the advisory inbox via the form on /careers.

roles.title: Scheme Research Writer (English / Hindi)
roles.summary: Turn government notifications, GRs and guidelines into clear, accurate scheme guides that founders can act on.
points: Read and summarise official scheme documents
Write plain-language guides with eligibility, documents and steps
Keep pages updated when limits or rules change

roles.title: Loan & Subsidy Advisor (Regional)
roles.summary: Work with MSMEs in your region to prepare project reports and scheme applications, and liaise with banks and DICs.
points: Experience with MSME credit, banking or DIC processes
Strong in UP, Gujarat or Maharashtra (more states soon)
roles.pay: Success-based commission + retainer for top performers

roles.title: Video Creator — Scheme Explainers
roles.summary: Script and record short Hindi/English explainers on schemes, eligibility and how to apply, for YouTube and social.
points: Comfortable on camera or as a voice-over artist
Accuracy first — every claim checked against official sources

roles.title: Campus & District Ambassador
roles.summary: Spread awareness of free government schemes among students, founders and small businesses in your city or campus.
points: Run awareness sessions and social posts
Refer businesses to a free assessment (with their consent)
Earn rewards, certificates and recommendation letters

roles.title: Partnerships & Growth Associate
roles.summary: Build partnerships with CAs, incubators, industry associations and lenders, and grow the site's reach.
points: Comfort with sponsorship and lead-partner deals
Bonus: experience in fintech, MSME or media sales
